mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM customer WHERE customer_id = #{customerId})

SELECT c.display_name AS displayName, c.is_synthetic AS synthetic, ms.age_band AS ageBand, ms.life_stage AS lifeStage, ms.credit_membership_months AS creditMembershipMonths, ms.member_delinquency_flag AS memberDelinquencyFlag, pr.prediction_id AS predictionId, CASE WHEN pr.prediction_id IS NULL THEN 'NOT_ANALYZED' WHEN pr.llm_status = 'FAILED' THEN 'PARTIAL' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END AS analysisStatus, CASE pr.risk_grade WHEN '정상' THEN 'NORMAL' WHEN '관심' THEN 'INTEREST' WHEN '주의' THEN 'CAUTION' WHEN '경고' THEN 'WARNING' END AS riskGrade, pr.risk_grade AS riskGradeName, pr.hazard_1m AS hazard1m, pr.hazard_2m AS hazard2m, pr.hazard_3m AS hazard3m, pr.percentile, pr.predicted_at AS predictedAt, ms.credit_usage_amount_r3m AS creditUsageAmountR3m, ms.valid_credit_card_count AS validCreditCardCount, ms.available_credit_card_count AS availableCreditCardCount, ms.used_credit_card_count AS usedCreditCardCount, bs.billed_amount_b0 AS billedAmountB0, bs.delinquency_count_r3m AS delinquencyCountR3m, bs.on_due_date_payment_month_count_r3m AS onDueDatePaymentMonthCountR3m, bs.prepayment_count_r3m AS prepaymentCountR3m, cs.credit_limit_amount AS creditLimitAmount, cs.cash_advance_limit_amount AS cashAdvanceLimitAmount, cs.revolving_agreed_billing_rate AS revolvingAgreedBillingRate, bals.balance_b0m AS balanceB0m, bals.cash_advance_balance_b0m AS cashAdvanceBalanceB0m, bals.card_loan_balance_b0m AS cardLoanBalanceB0m, bals.revolving_lump_sum_carryover_balance_b0m AS revolvingCarryoverBalanceB0m FROM feature_snapshot fs JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = fs.customer_id LEFT JOIN member_snapshot ms ON ms.customer_id = fs.customer_id AND ms.base_ym = fs.base_ym LEFT JOIN billing_snapshot bs ON bs.customer_id = fs.customer_id AND bs.base_ym = fs.base_ym LEFT JOIN credit_snapshot cs ON cs.customer_id = fs.customer_id AND cs.base_ym = fs.base_ym LEFT JOIN balance_snapshot bals ON bals.customer_id = fs.customer_id AND bals.base_ym = fs.base_ym LEFT JOIN prediction_result pr ON pr.prediction_id = ( SELECT candidate.prediction_id FROM prediction_result candidate WHERE candidate.feature_snapshot_id = fs.feature_snapshot_id AND candidate.model_version = #{modelVersion} ORDER BY candidate.predicted_at DESC, candidate.prediction_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE fs.customer_id = #{customerId} AND fs.base_ym = #{baseYm} LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT base_ym AS baseYm, credit_membership_months AS creditMembershipMonths, valid_credit_card_count AS validCreditCardCount, available_credit_card_count AS availableCreditCardCount, used_credit_card_count AS usedCreditCardCount, credit_usage_amount_r3m AS creditUsageAmountR3m, member_delinquency_flag AS memberDelinquencyFlag FROM member_snapshot WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND base_ym <= #{baseYm} ORDER BY base_ym DESC LIMIT #{months} ) recent ORDER BY baseYm ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT base_ym AS baseYm, billed_amount_b0 AS billedAmountB0, billed_amount_r3m AS billedAmountR3m, delinquency_count_r3m AS delinquencyCountR3m, delinquency_count_r6m AS delinquencyCountR6m, on_due_date_payment_month_count_r3m AS onDueDatePaymentMonthCountR3m, prepayment_count_r3m AS prepaymentCountR3m FROM billing_snapshot WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND base_ym <= #{baseYm} ORDER BY base_ym DESC LIMIT #{months} ) recent ORDER BY baseYm ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT base_ym AS baseYm, credit_limit_amount AS creditLimitAmount, cash_advance_limit_amount AS cashAdvanceLimitAmount, credit_limit_amount_b1m AS creditLimitAmountB1m, forced_limit_reduction_count_r12m AS forcedLimitReductionCountR12m, forced_limit_reduction_amount_r12m AS forcedLimitReductionAmountR12m, voluntary_limit_reduction_count_r12m AS voluntaryLimitReductionCountR12m, limit_increase_count_r12m AS limitIncreaseCountR12m, limit_review_request_count AS limitReviewRequestCount, limit_request_rejection_count AS limitRequestRejectionCount, market_short_delinquency_flag_r3m AS marketShortDelinquencyFlagR3m, market_short_delinquency_flag_r6m AS marketShortDelinquencyFlagR6m, revolving_agreed_billing_rate AS revolvingAgreedBillingRate FROM credit_snapshot WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND base_ym <= #{baseYm} ORDER BY base_ym DESC LIMIT #{months} ) recent ORDER BY baseYm ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT base_ym AS baseYm, balance_b0m AS balanceB0m, lump_sum_balance_b0m AS lumpSumBalanceB0m, installment_balance_b0m AS installmentBalanceB0m, cash_advance_balance_b0m AS cashAdvanceBalanceB0m, card_loan_balance_b0m AS cardLoanBalanceB0m, revolving_lump_sum_carryover_balance_b0m AS revolvingCarryoverBalanceB0m, cash_advance_balance_b1m AS cashAdvanceBalanceB1m, card_loan_balance_b1m AS cardLoanBalanceB1m, monthly_average_balance AS monthlyAverageBalance FROM balance_snapshot WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND base_ym <= #{baseYm} ORDER BY base_ym DESC LIMIT #{months} ) recent ORDER BY baseYm ASC
